title: Mehman e Karbala
body:
Mehman e karabala Mehana e karbala
Mehman e karabala Mehana e karbala
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
Saathe che Sah e Dii(n) na...(2), Hamshir Karbala
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
1) Abbas masq la ne Jaase furaat par..(2)
Haatho Kapav'vana...(2), aye veer karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
2) Jene nihari sarwar nana ne yaad karta..(2)
Mar(d)vani khaaq ma a...(2), Tasveer Karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
3) Khaima ma tar-varey che, Baccha'O bhukiya pyaasa ..(2)
Piva madey na Tipu..(2) Na Neer Karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
4) Ummat ne rakhswaney, Chhodi ne god maani ..(2)
Zalim nu teer khase (2), Beshir Karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
5) Khaima jalavi zalim, Chadar luti gaya che ..(2)
Ahle-haram ni kevi..(2), Taqdeer Karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
6) Sultan Kana dhruje, aaje gagan ne dharti ..(2)
Thai jase Katl pyasa..(2) Shabbir Karbala ma
Mehaman Thai Ne aaviya Shabbir Karbala ma
Mehman e karabala Mehana e karbala
